_notes: TWO enforcement layers now ship, not one. (1) deny{} = literal-prefix denylist, fast but POROUS (casing/alternate-commands/quoting slip past) — kept as cheap first pass. (2) hooks.PreToolUse -> .claude/hooks/safety_gate.js = the real SEMANTIC gate: it inspects the actual tool call and blocks the one-way-door classes regardless of spelling — secret exfil (.env/secret/.pem/key/id_rsa via Read OR any shell verb incl. curl/scp/cp upload), irreversible destruction (rm -rf any-flag-order / force-push / reset --hard / DROP|TRUNCATE / recursive delete), prod-deploy+on-chain (vercel --prod / wrangler|netlify|firebase deploy / kubectl apply / terraform apply|destroy / npm publish / cast send / solana transfer), and kill-by-name (rail #12). It fails-OPEN on parse error (exit 0) so a hook bug can never brick a build; the deny-set still catches literals underneath. Tested block/allow/garbage before shipping (this is a LIVE hook, not a dead reference — the old 'hooks omitted by design' note is retired for the safety layer). allow{} ships a SAFE baseline so the non-stop builder loop doesn't stall on every tool call; the generator ADDS the type's extra hosts/tools at MATERIALIZE. allowedDomains starts EMPTY (no network) — the generator MUST scope it to the type's real API hosts; TIGHTEN asserts no {{placeholder}} survives.
